# Dispatcher fixtures

These small synthetic parser fixtures were moved byte for byte from the existing
`test-molecular-workbench-quantum.test.ts` template literals. They exercise analytic
hydrogen orbitals, mode-column ordering and ORCA geometry/energy association;
they are not independent calculation outputs. `ordered-spectra.hess` similarly
retains the literal from `test-workbench-hessian-spectra.test.ts`.
